assumptions: Claude Code applies a project's .claude/settings.json env block to plugin-spawned MCP server processes — the issue author's own proposal relies on this and their environment demonstrates the settings surface; server-side behavior is verified independently of it.
context: Implemented #46: TWINING_PROJECT env var for shared stores — resolution --project arg > env > cwd (relative env values resolve against cwd), plugin 1.17.0 drops its hardcoded --project . which would have shadowed the env var. Verified end-to-end with the built binary.
rationale: preserves the pre-#46 arg contract exactly (no regression) while giving env users predictable semantics; absolute paths documented as recommended for multi-machine setups.
summary: Chose to resolve relative TWINING_PROJECT values against the server cwd while passing explicit --project values through verbatim
